notes: Davie et al. 2018 (Cell; GSE107451; FBrf0239740), rebuilt from GEO to replace the old FlyBase/SCEA load FBlc0006090 (E-CURD-91); fresh VFBseq ids, no FBlc link (curator decision). Scope: the paper's 57K stringently filtered 10x set only - 26 GSMs (12 DGRP-551, 14 w1118; adults 0-50 d), selected by sample_build.title_pattern regex. 26 Samples / 26 Assays. 2026-10-05 restructure (curator decision): one row per AUTHOR CLUSTER, never merged by cell type; typing from the authors, not re-analysis. 7 Clusterings / 125 Clusters (projects/davie_2018/build_clusters.py): 87 res-2.0 (Table S2), 5 S2-annotated res-8.0, sub-clusterings of res-2.0 20/27/42/64 (5+9+2+2), 15 neuropeptide re-clustering groups. The 18 sub-clusters are linked to their parent res-2.0 cluster via parent_cluster (BFO:0000050 part of; new schema slot); res-8.0 and neuropeptide clusters have no parent. Cluster type = authors' GEO annotation (sub-clustered parents take the S2 parent call); Table S2 recorded per cluster, 14 clusters with a differing S2 call flagged (author_conflict -> verification_needed); 42 unannotated clusters held. Type-level mappings (type_mapping/) by map-clusters-to-fbbt subagents from per-type reports; 21 types re-mapped on 2026-10-05 under the face-value rule (authors' named type -> that FBbt term; grouped calls -> common parent; no downgrading from our own marker/contamination reading); copied per cluster into mapping/. 82 clusters mapped; 43 held (42 left numbered by the authors + Hsp, which has no FBbt term - general rule: no FBbt term -> held). new_term_needed is recorded for Poxn and Proc/Gpb5 but no requests will be made (expression-only terms are the exception). Curator hand edits (manual_edit): Photoreceptors -> rhabdomeric photoreceptor cell; Mip/OCT -> adult myoinhibitory peptide neuron; Mip/ITP -> Mip + ITP neuron; AstA/NPF -> AstA + adult NPF neuron; Proc/Ms -> Ms neuron. No Cluster stage (stage is on Samples; Cluster stage only when determined from expression). All 62 distinct FBbt terms verified current/non-obsolete/label-match against live OLS FBbt (scripts/verify_mappings.py); OLS MCP was returning 503 during the re-map, so agents looked terms up via the OLS4 REST API / local fbbt-full.obo / VFB. Old FBlc0006090 FBbt terms (crosswalked by author type) agree for 60 typed clusters, differ for 6 (all the more specific adult / adult-brain term chosen here). Sex mixed (20F+20M brains per run; slot unset). Stocks FBst0055026 / FBst0003605 via Chado. Stages FBdv 'day N of adulthood'; tissue FBbt:00003624 adult brain. Expression per Clustering from a barcode->cluster membership file (a cell counted once per Clustering): 284,188 cluster x gene rows (extent>0.2) over 17,473 genes / 56,902 cells; dataset total/filtered gene counts 14,463/6,707. Publication FBrf0239740 resolved from VFB production (pdb) by PMID; not in the curation KB. (Earlier KB 401s were caused by the curator's VFB_KB_* env vars for the writable KB being picked up; pub.py now uses VFBSEQ_* overrides.) The 57K MEX tarball was unpacked and re-gzipped into .cache; checksums are of the re-gzipped files. Gene ids mapped to current FlyBase genes (FB2026_03, FlyBase Chado; gene_id_map.tsv via scripts/update_gene_ids.py): 132 secondary ids -> current gene (5 merges, counts summed per cell), 5 split ids and 1 withdrawn id (snRNA:U3) dropped, symbols refreshed; 284,038 expression rows; dataset total/filtered gene counts 14,456/6,704. 2026-10-14 (curator decision): clusters with no FBbt term (held) are no longer loaded - listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason, but given no VFBseq id (previously minted ids removed from the registry, never reused), no Cluster entity and no expression; 43 held clusters (42 the authors left numbered, 1 type with no FBbt term: Hsp) left out; 82 Clusters loaded; expression 194,453 rows (dataset total/filtered gene counts 13,362 / 6,577).
